title: New tall white arrivals come too close at Range Three
place_text: Range Three, Indian Springs Valley, Nevada

tellings.quote: One night I was out in range three and a group of new arrivals, it was after the full moon, a week or so,

plain: One night in 1965, about a week after the full moon, a group of newly arrived "tall whites", tall pale beings he says lived near a Nevada air base, came too close to Charles Hall while he was out at Range Three in Indian Springs Valley. Hall, who says he worked there as an Air Force weather observer and spent years around these beings, tells Michels this as his own experience. If true, it would mean non-human beings were living alongside US military staff.
